description: Are there recalls on this car? Lists every US safety recall NHTSA holds for a make, model and model year, newest first, with the faulty component, the risk, the remedy and do-not-drive or park-outside warnings. For owners, used-car buyers and fleet managers. Source: NHTSA Recalls API. It lists recalls for the model, not whether a particular car has been repaired (check that by VIN with the maker or at nhtsa.gov), and it does not cover UK (DVSA) recalls. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, max recalls to return, 1-100, default 25

make.description: string, required, vehicle make, e.g. honda, ford, tesla

model.description: string, required, US model name, e.g. accord, f-150, model 3

name: vehicle_recalls
